test_to_numpy_basic_conversion: test the DataFrame.to_numpy method to convert a DataFrame to a numpy array
test_to_numpy_with_dtype: test the DataFrame.to_numpy method with a dtype parameter to cast values to int64
test_to_numpy_copy_behavior: test the DataFrame.to_numpy method with copy parameter to control array copying
test_to_numpy_mixed_dtype_to_string: test the DataFrame.to_numpy method with dtype=str to convert mixed types to strings
test_to_numpy_datetime_with_na_values: test the DataFrame.to_numpy method with float dtype and na_value to handle datetime with NaN
